reason_for_new_version: The v4 shared Lean sources changed while closing the generic learned domain, executed transition decisions and analyzer dependencies. Their frozen hashes no longer describe the compared material. Version 6 preserves v4 and freezes the corrected material together with six compiled typed adapters.
scientific_scope: Capacity comparison on one exact learned artifact family and one exact aligned/bypass update pair. It is neither a universal impossibility claim nor a practical performance claim.
run_blocker: A stable repository commit must be recorded after this content-addressed adapter freeze and before the single confirmatory command is executed.
same_material_rules: All six adapters are fields of one FrozenNeuralComparisonAdapterBundle indexed by one FrozenNeuralComparisonMaterial.
Every adapter consumes the byte-identical source artifact and exact aligned/bypass candidate pair.
Current behavior is evaluated on exactly the four inputs enumerated by learnedRuntimeDeclaredCurrentDomain.
Future behavior is evaluated on exactly the nonempty learnedOperationalCounterfactualRequests list.
An adapter may expose less evidence than the constitutive runtime, but it may not replace the artifact, candidate, intent, domain, future request or target contract.
A baseline-specific summary is never accepted as a substitute for the shared serialized material.

capability_status_vocabulary.certified: A checked theorem or certificate establishes the capability for the exact shared material.
capability_status_vocabulary.observed: The frozen compiled adapter returns direct evidence on the exact shared material, without a theorem claim.
capability_status_vocabulary.not-certified: The adapter ran but supplied no certificate of the capability; this does not assert impossibility or absence.
capability_status_vocabulary.out-of-interface: The frozen baseline interface does not express the capability; this does not assert impossibility or absence.

baselines.interface: candidate artifact times complete declared current domain to output table and verdict
baselines.comparison_output: current-table equality and agreement of every verifier factored only through that table

baselines.interface: fixed candidate artifact times declared intervention basis to causal observation report
baselines.comparison_output: authorization dependency for both exact candidates and executed causal roles for the aligned fixed network

baselines.interface: candidate action times current policy state to allow or refuse before effect
baselines.comparison_output: allow/refuse decision for both exact candidates and non-installation of the rejected bypass

baselines.interface: certified current system times proof-free proposed update times invariant to certified successor or rejection
baselines.comparison_output: installed aligned successor, rejected bypass, checked step and transported contract evidence

baselines.interface: checked source artifact times serialized delta times source certificate to checked target certificate or rejection
baselines.comparison_output: exact aligned/bypass verdicts and actual transported/recomputed fragment counts; no reuse claim when the learned cone covers every target observation

baselines.interface: finite proof-free update trace times initial checked runtime to dependent checked history or first rejection
baselines.comparison_output: exact accepted transition count, checked history, preserved contracts, reachability and source rejection

extensional_limitation.scope: verifiers whose verdict factors exclusively through the complete declared current table
extensional_limitation.forbidden_generalization: No limitation is inferred for verifiers that consume causal, historical, future or contract-indexed material.

pre_registered_decision_rules: The confirmatory run executes all six content-addressed adapters in one compiled command.
Missing output and out-of-interface capabilities are never negative results.
Certified, observed and not-certified are reported separately and never collapsed into one score.
No result may infer a universal impossibility from one baseline implementation.
The extensional limitation may be reported only at its stated factorization boundary.
The learned incremental adapter reports zero transported structural fragments and makes no local-reuse claim for this exact material.
Timing and resource measurements belong to a separately versioned protocol.
Any change to shared material, interface, adapter source, capability, decision rule or schema requires a later protocol version.
